Name: Trash Does Not Consume Bait
Author: Atravita
TagLine: Trash no longer consumes bait. Bonus: automatic refilling of tackles/bait!
Description:
This mod prevents trash from consuming bait. Additionally, it adds automatic replacement of tackles/bait when they run out. When replacing, the code will try to use the same bait/tackle you were using, but if you don't have that particular tackle/bait remaining in your inventory, it can optionally use whatever you have on hand. It will only use bait/tackle in your inventory.

Install

1.  Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io).

2.  Download and install [AtraCore](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12932).

3.  Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

4.  Run the game using SMAPI.
Configuration
Run SMAPI at least once with this mod installed to generate the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font], or use [Generic Mod Config Menu](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098) to configure.

1.  [font=Courier New]AutomaticRefill[/font]: Toggles the automatic refill feature.

2.  [font=Courier New]SameTackleOnly[/font]: Replacement tackles have to be the same type as the one used up.

3.  [font=Courier New]SameBaitOnly[/font]: Replacement bait have to be the same type as the one used up.

4.  [font=Courier New]ConsumeChanceNormal[/font]: The probability that a fishing rod without the Preserving enchantment consumes bait/tackle. (Default: 1 = 100%)

5.  [font=Courier New]ConsumeChancePreserving[/font]: The probability that a fishing rod with the Preserving enchantment consumes bait/tackle. (Default: 0.5 = 50%)

6.  [font=Courier New]CrabPotTrashDoesNotEatBait[/font]: Whether crab pot trash should eat bait.
Compatibility

*   Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.

*   Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. Should be fine if installed for one player only.

*   Should be compatible with most other mods. (If you use [Everlasting Bait and Unbreakable Tackles](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2360), you may see the stack size of your bait increase or your tackle repair though. [Unbreakable Tackles](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7719) is closed source - or at least I couldn't find the source - so I don't know how this mod interacts with that one. You could alternately just set the consume chance to be zero though.)
Technical note: this mod transpiles [font=Courier New]FishingRod.doDoneFishing[/font], so it's not likely to be compatiable with any mod that also transpiles that function.
